title: Detecting Data Contamination in LLMs via In-Context Learning
authors_zh: Michał Zawalski, Meriem Boubdir, Klaudia Bałazy, Besmira Nushi, Pablo Ribalta
paper_type_zh: 数据污染检测与基准审计方法
best_for_zh: 需要在已知或未知预训练语料下审计语言模型评测污染的研究者。
one_line: CoDeC measures the change induced by in-context examples to identify memorized benchmark data.
以同分布上下文是否降低 token 置信度，量化语言模型对候选数据集的污染风险。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: 以同分布上下文造成的置信度下降构造可解释污染分数，并在已知训练语料模型上以 99.9% 数据集级 AUC 区分已见与未见数据。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Contamination makes benchmark scores look like generalization even when a language model has memorized the evaluated distribution. Existing loss, membership, and overlap checks often need the training corpus, tuning, or hard-to-interpret thresholds, so they are difficult to use across models.

CoDeC turns in-context learning into a dataset-level audit. It asks whether same-dataset context improves or instead lowers confidence on a target sequence, and aggregates that signed change into an interpretable contamination percentage. It targets systematic score inflation from a dataset or a related distribution entering training, rather than whether one question is answered correctly; the audit unit is the candidate dataset.

数据污染会让基准分数看似反映泛化，其实语言模型已记住被评测的数据分布。现有损失、成员推断和重叠检查常需训练语料、参数调节或难解释阈值，因而难在不同模型间稳定使用。

CoDeC 将上下文学习改造成数据集级审计：它考察同一数据集的示例是提高目标序列置信度，还是反而降低置信度，并把这种有符号变化汇总为可解释的污染百分比。它关注的是评测数据集或相近分布已进入训练而造成的系统性偏高，而不是单一道题答对与否；因此审计单位是整个候选数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CoDeC treats a negative change in a target sequence's average log-likelihood after prepending random same-dataset examples as evidence of contamination: unseen context usually supplies useful information, whereas context that triggers an already memorized distribution can disrupt prediction. The method needs token probabilities but neither training data nor a learned detector; it contributes an audit score rather than a released benchmark dataset or training corpus. The score is the fraction of targets with a negative shift, enabling comparison across models and datasets; it is not a per-record membership probability.
CoDeC 把加入随机同源示例后目标序列平均对数似然的负向变化视为污染证据：未见数据的上下文通常提供有用信息，而触发已记忆分布的上下文可能扰乱预测。它只需 token 概率，不需训练数据或另训检测器；产物是审计分数，并未发布新的基准数据集或训练语料。该分数可用于比较模型、数据集和训练阶段。分数的含义是负向变化的样本比例，便于与不同模型、不同候选数据集并列阅读；但它不是逐条成员关系的概率。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select a suspect text dataset and fix one item as the target; obtain the model's average next-token log-likelihood without demonstrations.
  2. Sample n other items from the same dataset, prepend them as in-context examples, and score only the target again.
  3. Subtract the baseline confidence from the contextual confidence for that target. A negative difference is the method's contamination indicator rather than a tuned threshold.
  4. Repeat over all sampled targets and report the percentage with negative differences as the CoDeC score. The standard form requires two forward passes per target and gray-box token probabilities.
  5. Compare scores on known training versus post-cutoff datasets or audit unknown-corpus models. Recheck dataset serialization, context count, sampling seed, tokenizer, and any unavailable logits before reproducing a score.

1. 选定可疑文本数据集，固定一条记录为目标，并取得无示例时的平均下一 token 对数似然。
  2. 从同一数据集抽取 n 条其他记录置于目标前，作为上下文示例后再次只评分目标。
  3. 计算有上下文与基线置信度之差；差值为负即记为污染指示，不依赖调节阈值。
  4. 对抽样目标重复并汇总负差比例，得到 CoDeC 分数。标准形式每条需两次前向计算，且要求灰盒 token 概率。
  5. 用已知训练数据与截止日期后数据对照，或审计未知语料模型；复现时须固定序列化、上下文数、随机种子、tokenizer，并记录缺失 logits。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — CoDeC separates data known to have entered training from genuinely unseen datasets more reliably than common score-based detectors.

Setup — the main validation used Pythia, GPT-Neo, RWKV-4, OLMo, Nemotron-v2, and Nemotron-H models with disclosed corpora; each test bed paired training-corpus subsets with post-cutoff text. Vanilla loss, Min-K%, and zlib ratio were baselines.

Result — dataset-level AUC pooled over models was 99.9% for CoDeC, versus 75.7%, 78.5%, and 89.6% respectively. In controlled finetuning, scores rose above 90% after exposure to each chosen dataset.

Boundary — this is dataset-level separation under available token probabilities and selected corpora; a high score can also reflect related distributions, not proof that every evaluated string was copied verbatim.

主张——CoDeC 比常见分数式检测器更可靠地区分已进入训练的数据和真正未见的数据集。

设置——主验证覆盖训练语料公开的 Pythia、GPT-Neo、RWKV-4、OLMo、Nemotron-v2 与 Nemotron-H；每个测试床把训练语料子集与截止日期后的文本配对，并比较 Vanilla loss、Min-K% 和 zlib ratio。

结果——跨模型汇总的数据集级 AUC 为 99.9%，三种基线分别为 75.7%、78.5% 和 89.6%。受控微调后，各选定数据集的分数均升至 90% 以上。

边界——证据是在可得 token 概率和选定语料下的数据集级区分；高分也可能反映相关分布，不能证明每条文本被逐字复制。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Loss and membership scores assess a sample's likelihood or rare-token behavior, normally on an absolute scale that needs calibration. CoDeC instead changes the input by adding same-dataset demonstrations and uses the direction of the target's confidence shift. The change is therefore an intervention-based, percentage-valued dataset score. Its novelty is not in-context learning itself, but using its failure to help as a contamination signal that can also surface exposure to augmented or related distributions. This relative change also avoids treating absolute likelihoods from different architectures as one scale and makes the intervention behind a comparison explicit.

损失和成员推断通常从样本似然或罕见 token 行为取绝对分数，往往需要校准。CoDeC 改变输入：加入同数据集示例，并观察目标置信度变化方向，因此得到干预式、百分比化的数据集分数。新意不在于使用上下文学习，而在于把“上下文未带来帮助”转为污染信号；它还能提示经增强数据或相关分布带来的暴露。该设计使审计结论更易跨模型比较。这种相对变化也避免把不同架构的绝对似然直接混为同一量纲，使报告能明确说明比较来自何种上下文干预。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors state that CoDeC requires gray-box access to token probabilities, excluding many API-only frontier models. It is also a dataset-level indicator: related data, style, or augmentation can elevate a score without establishing exact record membership. Their analysis warns that highly diverse datasets can retain scores near 50% across models, so a threshold should not be applied mechanically. Before reuse, construct matched post-cutoff controls and inspect score distributions rather than treating one percentage as a verdict. For products without log-probability access, any substitute must be validated separately; apparent confidence in generated text is not the same signal.

作者明确指出 CoDeC 需要灰盒 token 概率，因此不能直接用于多数仅提供文本输出的前沿 API。它也是数据集级指示：相关数据、文体或增强样本可抬高分数，却不能证明精确记录成员关系。论文还提示，高多样性数据集可能在不同模型上稳定停留在约 50%，故不能机械套用阈值。复用前应构造截止日期后匹配对照，检查分数分布并人工核验异常来源。对于没有对数概率接口的产品，替代方案必须另行验证，不能把模型生成的文本置信感当作同一信号。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An evaluation team with an open-weight model and candidate benchmark texts can run CoDeC before reporting scores: serialize each item, sample same-source demonstrations, save both likelihoods, and produce a per-dataset audit percentage. Success is clean separation from matched post-cutoff controls and stable results over resampling. Model developers can additionally monitor the score during training to flag early leaks. Do not use it as a black-box API test when token log-probabilities are unavailable, or as proof of verbatim copying without follow-up evidence. For multiple versions of one benchmark, audit train, validation, and test partitions separately rather than extrapolating one partition's result.

拥有开源模型和候选基准文本的评测团队，可在公布成绩前运行 CoDeC：统一序列化每条记录，抽取同源示例，保存两种似然并输出数据集审计比例。成功标准是与匹配的截止日期后对照清晰分离，且重抽样后稳定。模型开发者还可在训练中监测分数以发现早期泄漏。若没有 token 对数概率，或需要证明逐字复制而无后续证据，则不应把它当作黑盒定论。对于同一基准的多个版本，应分别审计训练、验证和测试划分，避免把一个划分的结论外推到其余划分。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: CoDeC audits dataset contamination from the direction of an in-context confidence change, not from answer accuracy.
  2. Method handle: score a target alone and with random same-dataset context; only a negative delta counts toward the percentage.
  3. Artifact handle: the paper exposes a public supplementary-material link, but this is a method and audit protocol rather than a new labeled training dataset.
  4. Evidence anchor: on disclosed-corpus models, pooled dataset-level AUC is 99.9%, above zlib ratio at 89.6%.
  5. Reuse decision: suitable with logits and matched controls; first test sampling, serialization, and related-distribution false alarms.

1. 定位：CoDeC 用上下文置信度变化方向审计数据集污染，而非用答题准确率。
  2. 方法：目标单独评分，再加随机同源上下文评分；只有负差进入百分比分子。
  3. 产物：论文公开补充材料链接；其核心是方法与审计协议，而非新的带标注训练集。
  4. 证据：语料公开模型上的汇总数据集级 AUC 为 99.9%，高于 zlib ratio 的 89.6%。
  5. 决策：适合有 logits 与匹配对照的审计；先测试抽样、序列化和相关分布导致的误报。
